cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll carry one box. Count before you start loading, the way I taught you on your first move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move the whole storeroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've remembered the help, at least. Now read the rest: one box. Put one by the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Label it 'one' before I lift it, just as I showed you. Once that box is in the van, don't put another under the same label.
